summary.zh-Hant: 斯匹茨卑爾根條約生效：挪威正式接管斯瓦巴
summary.en: The Spitsbergen Treaty takes effect: Norway formally takes over Svalbard

citations.evidenceNote: 1920-02-09 巴黎簽字的斯匹茨卑爾根條約，承認挪威對斯瓦巴群島的主權。

timeNote.zh-Hant: 條約 1920-02-09 簽字；1925-08-14 挪威正式接管為通行說法（開發庫既有挪威紀錄起日）。
timeNote.en: Signed 9 Feb 1920; Norwegian takeover on 14 Aug 1925 per common accounts (start of the existing Norway record).
